name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's racing journey began in the snowy expanses of Quebec, initially fueled by a passion for snowmobiles before transitioning to karting in his late teens. He quickly displayed an aptitude for understanding vehicle dynamics and race tactics, leading him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering with a focus on motorsport. After graduating, Jean-Pierre honed his skills as a data analyst and junior strategist with smaller racing teams, gradually building a reputation for his calm demeanor and ability to make critical decisions under pressure.

Joining Team Gtechniq was a significant step, allowing him to work with cutting-edge technology and talented drivers. Jean-Pierre's pragmatic approach emphasizes data-driven decisions and a deep understanding of tire management. He is known for his ability to anticipate track evolution and adjust strategies accordingly, often giving his team a crucial edge. His colleagues admire his meticulous preparation and his talent for explaining complex scenarios in clear, concise terms, making him an invaluable asset during high-stakes races.

physical.description: A slightly built man with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of herbal tea during race weekends.
